annotations.title: Equinoxes, solstices, perihelion and day length over a year

description: Equinoxes and solstices of a year, Earth's perihelion and aphelion, and optionally the Sun day by day (sunrise, sunset, day length, declination, equation of time) for a place. E.g. {year: 2026}. For calendars, almanacs, education and solar apps: the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices (UTC, and local with a place), Earth's perihelion and aphelion with their distances, and with daily=true a row per day: solar noon, the Sun's apparent declination, the equation of time and, for a place, sunrise, sunset and day length, plus the longest and shortest days. Matches the published 2026 times to the minute. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.01 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/astronomy/seasons (x402 or MPP); each client gets 1 free call on the $0.01-0.02 tools, this one included.

daily.description: Add one row per day: solar noon, the Sun's declination, the equation of time and, with a place, sunrise, sunset and day length.
